is a reference to the game show ''Jeopardy!'' ** The song title is a play on the title of the show, and the song itself is very similar to the show’s Think Music played during the ''Final Jeopardy!'' round. *The song Godly Imagination is a reference to "Pure Imagination" by Gene Wilder from the 1971 film ''Willy Wonka & the Chocolate Factory''. *Two [[Emblems]] are unlocked through the Harp: "Harp Note" by completing all songs and "Harp Master" by perfecting all songs. == History == {{History table |beta= {{history|2019/Nov 11|Added '''Harp'''.}} }}
